gen-dafont-outrun-future-gf-anek-gujarat: Anek Gujarati reads as sans-serif with lowercase so tall it rivals the capitals. Over a long passage that gaping c opening keeps things easy going, while Outrun Future's single-depth, engraver-style cut stays up in the headline.
gen-dafont-outrun-future-gf-anek-gurmukh: Clean, wide-spaced Outrun Future ends every stroke as thick as its middle, with a large x-height and short ascenders. Anek Gurmukhi, a sans-serif, gives a long passage big open counters and generous round curves that keep the text moving.
gen-dafont-outrun-future-gf-anek-kannada: Wide, synthwave, and monoline. Outrun Future runs one stroke from start to finish, while Anek Kannada's high, squared-off x-height and far-flung terminals make a longer passage feel open and sturdy in sans-serif form.
gen-dafont-outrun-future-gf-anek-latin: Authoritative Outrun Future spreads wide with a ballpoint's pressure-free line, and its large x-height sits over short ascenders. But Anek Latin, a plain sans, holds tall lowercase nearly at capital height with letters held open.
gen-dafont-outrun-future-gf-anek-odia: Clean Anek Odia keeps its rounds unlatched and its capitals only slightly above the lowercase, which sits neatly under Outrun Future's wide, hairline-free headings. And since those strokes never thin out, the heading holds up even at modest sizes.
gen-dafont-outrun-future-gf-anek-tamil: Anek Tamil reads with big round lowercase bowls in sans-serif, its c and s looking half unwrapped. Outrun Future counters with wide letter spacing and one fixed nib width, a synthwave authority the body never tries to match.
gen-dafont-outrun-future-gf-anek-telugu: Anek Telugu reads with a rhythm of wide, tall bowls and rounds left unlatched, like hooks that never close, in sans-serif form. Outrun Future's single line weight can go large above it.
gen-dafont-outrun-future-gf-anuphan: Outrun Future writes as if with a fixed pen, wide-spaced and synthwave, with a large x-height and short ascenders. And Anuphan, a plain sans, supplies big round lowercase bowls and open curves with clear gaps beneath it.
